title: Venezuelan Ceviche
description: A refreshing and zesty dish from Venezuela, made with raw fish marinated in citrus juices. This recipe is perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Ceviche mix (onion, garlic, aji amarillo pepper)

instructions: Cut the fish into small pieces and place in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together lime juice, ceviche mix, and aji amarillo pepper sauce (if using).
Pour the lime juice mixture over the fish and mix well.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the fish to marinate.
Just before serving, stir in chopped kiwifruit and cilantro.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
